items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yes. In the Bible, the intellect is symbolized by King Herod, who is looking for the Christ-child that he’s been told is coming, and so slaughters all the children. This is what the intellect does in the heart of the human being that engages the intellect over the spirit. The intellect is a great servant to the spirit, but it is a tyrant if it is used instead of the spirit. It will murder the Christ-child.
